    • location

      public IndexWriter.JarSpec location(long offset, long length, long localHeaderOffset)
      Sets where the jar sits in the outer archive.

      For the application layer, which is the outer archive itself, the offsets are 0 and the length is the length of the whole file.

      Parameters:
      offset - the absolute offset of the jar's first byte
      length - the length of the jar in bytes
      localHeaderOffset - the offset of the outer local file header introducing it
      Returns:
      this jar

    • addEntry

      public IndexWriter.EntrySpec addEntry(String logicalName)
      Adds an entry that physically exists in this jar. Entries must be added in the order the archive stores them, because that is the order the index preserves for enumeration.
      Parameters:
      logicalName - the name relative to this jar, which for the application layer is the outer entry name minus IndexFormat.CLASSES_PREFIX
      Returns:
      the entry, to set its sizes and offsets on
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if logicalName is null
      IllegalStateException - if the name is longer than the format allows

    • addEntry

      public IndexWriter.EntrySpec addEntry(String logicalName, ZipEntryInfo entry)
      Adds an entry described by a ZIP entry the packager already read, copying its sizes, checksum, timestamp and method.
      Parameters:
      logicalName - the name relative to this jar
      entry - the ZIP entry, whose ZipEntryInfo.dataOffset() is not used because the index needs an offset in the outer archive
      Returns:
      the entry, whose data offset still has to be set
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null

    • entries

      public List<IndexWriter.EntrySpec> entries()
      The entries added to this jar so far.
      Returns:
      the entries, in the order they were added
